messages:
maria: Hey team — I pushed the followups for #4123. Addressed the style nits, split a tiny helper out, and added the changelog entry. PTAL when you have a sec. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4123

jason: taking a look now, thank you. Quick Q: did you keep the original commits or squash?

maria: left history intact for now (helps with bisecting). If merge-ops prefers squash I can do that before cut.

priya: skimmed — code looks good to me. One tiny comment on the helper name (verb vs noun) but not blocking.

maria: updated the helper name to `requestRouter` per your suggestion. Also added a short test for the edge case.

alex: CI failing on a flake in e2e, unrelated to this change. I restarted the job.

merge-ops-bot: CI job restarted by alex — build #9845 in progress.

jason: thanks alex. Maria — can you add a one-line entry in RELEASE_NOTES.md about the behavior change? Keeps our release notes consistent.

maria: done, pushed that file. Also updated the changelog header with the module name.

priya: lgtm from me once the e2e finishes.

jason: looks good overall. I left one optional inline suggestion about a comment in the tests. Not a blocker.

maria: applied that suggestion and force-pushed. If everyone is happy, can we aim to merge in tonight's 6pm merge window?

alex: sounds fine. I'll watch the canary after merge.

jason: +1. @merge-ops can you reserve the 6pm slot and handle the cherry-pick if release branch needs it?

merge-ops-bot: Merge window requested by jason for 2026-03-18T18:00Z. Please ensure branch protection checks pass.

maria: thanks. PTAL for final thumbs. If nobody objects I'll either squash per ops guidance or keep history — whatever you prefer merge-ops. :slightly_smiling_face:

priya: :thumbsup:

jason: LGTM — approve from me.

alex: Approved.

maria: thanks all — assigning merge owner to alex. Will followup once canary looks healthy.

alex: grabbing merge ownership. Command I'll run:```bash
git checkout main
git fetch origin
git pull --rebase
git merge --no-ff feature/4123
git push origin main
```

maria: perfect — ping me if anything odd shows up so I can roll back the change quickly.

alex: will do. closing out here, thx everyone. :rocket:
